headline: Hims & Hers Rallies After Securing GLP-1 Supply Agreement With Eli Lilly
summary: Hims & Hers shares rallied after announcing a GLP-1 supply agreement with Eli Lilly. As part of the partnership, Hims stated it will no longer compound GLP-1 medications such as Zepbound.
why: Eli Lilly is a major pharmaceutical manufacturer and a primary developer of popular GLP-1 receptor agonist medications used for weight loss and diabetes management, significantly impacting the healthcare sector.
